items.title: Baker Mayfield: Pair of completions on first two series
items.body_text: Mayfield completed two of four passes for 10 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions in the Buccaneers' 16-15 preseason win over the Chiefs on Saturday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kenny Gainwell: One carry in team debut
items.body_text: Gainwell rushed once for no gain in the Buccaneers' 16-15 preseason win over the Chiefs on Saturday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bucky Irving: Logs three carries in preseason debut
items.body_text: Irving rushed three times for 14 yards in the Buccaneers' 16-15 preseason win over the Chiefs on Saturday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kenneth Walker: Logs first touches as a Chief
items.body_text: Walker rushed twice for four yards in the Chiefs' 16-15 preseason loss to the Buccaneers on Saturday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rome Odunze: Big gain on one catch Saturday
items.body_text: Odunze brought in one of two targets for 18 yards in the Bears' 27-9 preseason loss to the Bengals on Saturday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
